rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something happening or being reckoned every year.

example.english: The annual birthday party is always lively.
example.traditional: 每年嘅生日會都好熱鬧。
example.jyutping: mui5 nin4 ge3 saang1 jat6 wui6 dou1 hou2 jit6 naau6

rows.jyutping: mui5 nin4 jat1 ci3 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the event occurs exactly once each year.

example.english: This is the company's annual trip.
example.traditional: 呢個係每年一次嘅公司旅行。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 mui5 nin4 jat1 ci3 ge3 gung1 si1 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this mainly in official, institutional, or document labels such as annual reports and annual meetings.

example.english: The annual report must be submitted by Friday.
example.traditional: 年度報告要喺星期五前交。
example.jyutping: nin4 dou6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 hai2 sing1 kei4 ng5 cin4 gaau1

rows.note: Use this botanical term for a plant whose life cycle finishes within one growing season.

example.jyutping: suk1 mai5 hai6 jat1 nin4 saang1 zik6 mat6
